title: Azrieli International Postdoctoral Fellowship
about: Azrieli Foundation call for its International Postdoctoral Fellowship in Israel for the 2027-28 cohort. The online application opened August 9, 2026 and closes November 11, 2026.
card_alt: Card for the Azrieli International Postdoctoral Fellowship offered by The Azrieli Foundation in Israel, application deadline 11 Nov 2026. The photo is a generic default image, not of Israel: an aerial view of a city skyline with a tall tower beside a winding river at sunset.
